acceptanceCriteria: A context index build over a repository whose .gitignore (or a nested ignore file Git reads) is not a regular file refuses promptly with a named code instead of waiting for the git deadline.
A test covers the FIFO case.
body: observeRepository (internal/contextindex/index.go:380) runs git status through readStatusSnapshot. When a repository's .gitignore is a FIFO, git status blocks reading it and never returns (reproduced 2026-09-26: git init; mkfifo .gitignore; git status is still running after 10 s). The build then waits for gitDeadline (internal/contextindex/git.go:24, 30 s) and fails with a timeout instead of a prompt, named refusal. V1-0367 bounds Corvint's own readIgnoreFile to regular files; the git child still opens the FIFO.

completion.reason: Fixed in 56d025e7 (gitstatus refuses a FIFO or device ignore or attributes file). Contained in the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate 94ca556f52c0349c0a48e0c3a3274f8a0b5e6db3 on origin/main. Owner-approved closure 2026-09-27.

title: Context index build blocks on a FIFO .gitignore until the 30 s git deadline
